title: Grape Soda 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid by Seriously Slushy
description:
Seriously Slushy Grape Soda 100ml Shortfill features bold and sweet grapes with a fizzy soda and icy slush finish. Lightly effervescent, beautifully fruity and perfectly chilled.
Seriously Slushy Shortfills are brought to you by the team at justvapesaustralia Supplied in a 120ml shortfill bottle, containing 100ml of zero nicotine e-liquid. Simply mix in two 18mg nicotine shots to create an overall 3mg strength.
